title: Signature Command Buffer Recording
description: Records command buffers once and replays them to amortize CPU overhead. Static workloads record at startup; dynamic ones use per-frame buffers. It is how Vulkan achieves low driver overhead. This is a Signature original authored by Justin Addam Higgins — an original technique in the Signature system, clearly labeled Signature and not presented as public record.
